# aba-payway-ts

> ABA PayWay payment-gateway toolkit: a typed TypeScript SDK, an agent-first CLI
> (`payway-sdk`), and 35 installable agent skills — carrying sandbox-verified
> integration knowledge for ABA Bank PayWay (KHQR, hosted checkout, COF, payment
> links, payouts, pre-auth, webhooks).

Fast path from install to a first paid sandbox transaction:

```
npm install aba-payway-ts      # SDK + CLI + packaged agent skills
payway-sdk init                # scaffold .env + first-payment template
payway-sdk doctor --live       # prove a real sandbox round-trip
payway-sdk docs quickstart     # full quickstart, served offline by the CLI
payway-sdk onboard             # configure the LLM agent (ask / agent REPL)
```

Gateway facts most often gotten wrong (all sandbox-verified — see the errors &
debugging guide): `--lifetime` is SECONDS on generate-qr but MINUTES on
generate-checkout (prefer `--lifetime-minutes`); callbacks are single best-effort
delivery with NO guaranteed retry (verify via check-transaction); there is no
EXPIRED status remotely (expired transactions read PENDING forever); split-payout
keys are `{account,amount}` on generate-qr/payout but `{acc,amt}` on
generate-checkout/cof charge/payment-link.

## Docs

Every doc below is also served by the CLI itself, offline:
`payway-sdk docs list` · `payway-sdk docs <topic>` · `payway-sdk docs search <query>`

- [Integration profile and merchant gates](knowledge/integration-onboarding.md): Structured intake, onboarding, simulator evidence, G0–G7 and controlled production/rollback.
- [Integration contracts and callbacks](knowledge/integration-contracts.md): Source/version authority, callback variants and ACK, vectors, URL roles and inquiry policy.
- [Integration finance evidence](knowledge/integration-finance.md): Receipts, report grain, authoritative joins, batch-to-bank matching and settlement signoff.
- [Advanced integration operations](knowledge/integration-operations.md): Consent, billing, hold/refund/payout locks, monitoring, plugins and adjacent product boundaries.
- [Customer UI and mobile acceptance](knowledge/integration-ui.md): Verified UI states, QR/app handoff, accessibility, physical-device evidence and operator roles.
- [Merchant agent integration](knowledge/agent-integration.md): Project inspection, workflow capability/verification matrix, portable skill installation, recovery and production boundaries.
- [Express and Next.js integration recipes](knowledge/integration-recipes.md): Authenticated QR, hosted checkout and payment links; saved attempts, durable inbox, inquiry and fulfillment outbox.
- [Support and compatibility](knowledge/support.md): Runtime, verification limits, support scope, and sanitized bug reports.
- [Contributing](knowledge/contributing.md): Contributor setup, offline checks, gateway verification, and release review.
- [Security policy](knowledge/security.md): Private vulnerability reporting and disclosure policy; mailbox launch check remains required.
- [Storage service](knowledge/storage-service.md): Unified data root, JSON defaults, optional SQLite backend, and store ownership.
- [Quickstart](knowledge/quickstart.md): First sandbox payment end to end: credentials, .env, generate-qr, check-transaction, polling.
- [One-page quickstart](knowledge/quickstart-1-page.md): Condensed create→verify→fulfill reference for the impatient.
- [Docs index](knowledge/docs-index.md): The full documentation map: start-here routes, per-domain guides, troubleshooting.
- [Overview & concepts](knowledge/overview.md): PayWay model: merchant credentials, hash signing, sandbox vs production, payment options.
- [Prerequisites & setup](knowledge/setup.md): Merchant portal, sandbox credentials, ABA Mobile simulator, environment variables.
- [Web implementation](knowledge/web-implementation.md): Hosted checkout + server-side purchase flow for web apps, with callback verification.
- [Native app implementation](knowledge/native-apps.md): Android/iOS integration: deeplinks, webviews, return handling.
- [Webview implementation](knowledge/webviews.md): Mobile webview checkout patterns and deeplink return legs.
- [Telegram mini-app](knowledge/telegram-mini-app.md): PayWay checkout inside a Telegram mini-app.
- [QR code handling](knowledge/qr-handling.md): Online vs offline KHQR, scan-time validity windows, rendering and expiry semantics.
- [Deep linking](knowledge/deep-linking.md): abamobilebank:// deeplink scheme and return-leg handling.
- [COF link/unlink/renew lifecycle](knowledge/link-lifecycle.md): Credentials-on-file account/card lifecycle and token renewal.
- [UI customization](knowledge/ui-customization.md): Hosted checkout branding and view customization options.
- [Callbacks & webhooks](knowledge/callbacks-webhooks.md): Single best-effort callback delivery, HMAC verification, webhook workbench.
- [Errors & debugging](knowledge/errors-and-debugging.md): Every PayWay error code with sandbox-verified hints; the debugging playbook.
- [Deployment checklist](knowledge/deployment-checklist.md): Production go-live gates: credentials, RSA, callback URLs, base URL.
- [Appendix: code snippets](knowledge/code-snippets.md): Copy-paste hash signing, callback verification, and polling snippets.
- [Merchant scenario requirements](knowledge/merchant-scenarios.md): POS/billing/scenario requirements observed in real integrations.
- [Webhook setup guide](knowledge/webhook-setup.md): Local listener, tunnels, forwarding, and production webhook configuration.
- [Payment link](knowledge/payment-link.md): Payment-link create/detail/void contract incl. pushbacks and VOIDED semantics.
- [Transaction journal](knowledge/transaction-journal.md): CLI default recording, SDK opt-in, unified data root, timeline/stats/reconcile/anomalies.
- [Customer module QR](knowledge/customer-module-qr.md): Portal Customer-ID keyed QR generation and merchant-reference reconciliation.
- [Settlement & disputes](knowledge/settlement-disputes.md): Settlement timing, chargebacks, and refund boundaries per payment method.
- [API datetime & timezones](knowledge/api-datetime-timezones.md): Endpoint-specific UTC, UTC+7, epoch, naive datetime, callback, and parsing rules.
- [Cloudflare webhook (free tier)](knowledge/cloudflare-webhook.md): Free-tier Cloudflare Worker webhook receiver setup.
- [Agent setup playbook](knowledge/agent-setup-playbook.md): Configuring the agentic CLI: providers, capability modes, privacy ack.
- [Agentic CLI user guide](knowledge/agentic-cli-guide.md): ask / agent REPL / sessions / ledger — the full agent surface.
- [First payment walkthrough](knowledge/first-payment-walkthrough.md): Guided first sandbox payment with verification at each step.
- [Close transaction](knowledge/close-transaction.md): Channel-dependent close semantics: QR kill vs stale hosted-card sessions, the local closed flag, reconciliation.
- [SDK & CLI reference](knowledge/sdk-cli-reference.md): Every SDK domain method and CLI command with flags and contracts.
- [Error codes (machine)](knowledge/error-codes.json): Machine-readable error-code registry (generated by scripts/generate-error-registry.ts).


## Postman collection

The companion Postman workspace (`payway-boilerplate/Postman Collection API Testing/`, source repository only - not distributed in the npm package) ships a self-signing 46-request collection with saved examples, offline KHQR simulation and a scope matrix: merchant-facing guide `postman/documents/postman-guide.md`, AI index `llms.txt`, map `collection-index.md`.

## Agent integration

- `payway-sdk skills add <agent>` — install the 35 packaged skill guides for claude/codex/opencode/cursor/copilot.
- `payway-sdk ask "<request>"` — single-shot LLM plan with 14 PayWay tools (incl. `query_knowledge`).
- `payway-sdk agent` — interactive REPL; `agent doctor` shows the readiness matrix.
